instruction: Please help me save the embedded subtitle data from this video. Export the subtitles to a file named "transcript.srt" in the same location as the video.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting subtitles from video.mp4 and saving as transcript.srt. Evaluator verifies file exists and is non-empty.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves the subtitle file from the expected VM path (/home/user/transcript.srt)
Metric appropriately checks both file existence AND non-empty content (size > 0), which semantically verifies successful subtitle extraction
Complete coverage: instruction requires extracting subtitles to transcript.srt, evaluator verifies this requirement
Logical data flow is sound: getter fetches file from VM -> metric validates existence and content -> returns binary score
Edge cases handled properly: None return and missing files result in score 0.0
No postconfig needed: file operations don't require UI state preservation
